name: Dual-tier membership (Free + VIP)
description: Two-tier membership model: free base membership with core social access, and paid VIP membership (from 0.87 SEK/day, billed as 80 SEK/2 months, 190 SEK/6 months, or 320 SEK/year) unlocking inbox capacity, extra features, and fewer ads.
evidence_quote: VIP membership 2 months (80 SEK / ~€8) … VIP membership 1 year (320 SEK / ~€32). All for as little as from 0:87 SEK (~€0:09) / day

name: Friend + Follow dual social graph
description: Two distinct relationship primitives: bilateral 'Friends' (mutual add) and unilateral 'Followed persons' (asymmetric follow); each has its own list and feed filter.
evidence_quote: Jonj0's friends … Followed persons … None

name: Activity Feed with Mine / Everyone toggle
description: Chronological activity feed switchable between 'Mine' (friends-only activities) and 'Everyone' (global); a configurable selection filter further controls what activity types appear.
evidence_quote: Feed  👥 MINE 🌐 EVERYONE  ⚙️ SELECTION  You have no friends to display activities for.

name: New Material aggregated feed
description: Chronological reverse-feed of all newly published content across content types (Library, Discussions, Diaries, Calendar events, Interviews, Market ads), groupable or listed chronologically, with Mine / Everyone toggle.
evidence_quote: New material  👥 MINE 🌐 EVERYONE  ⊞ GROUPED 🕓 CHRONOLOGICAL  Library … Discussions … Diaries … Calendar … Interview … Market

name: Status messages (micro-posts with comments)
description: Short-form status posts visible on a global stream with 'Everyone / Followed / Friends' scope filters; other members can comment; users can clear their own status.
evidence_quote: Status messages  EVERYONE FOLLOWED FRIENDS … READ MORE / COMMENT

name: Private messaging with labels and picture attachments
description: Inbox-style direct messaging with conversation threading, user-created folder labels, picture attachments, and a storage quota (110 kB free, larger on VIP).
evidence_quote: Messages … ➕ CREATE NEW LABEL … Quota: 110 kB. Total used: 0 kB (0%). Remaining: 110 kB.

name: VIP expanded inbox and picture upload quota
description: VIP members receive space for thousands of messages (vs. ~110 kB free), can organize messages in folders, attach pictures to messages, and upload hundreds of photos.
evidence_quote: Space for thousands of messages in your inbox. You can organize them in folders and attach pictures. Upload hundreds of pictures.

name: Networks (interest-based groups)
description: Member-created topical groups (called Networks) covering hundreds of categories including kink identities, regional gatherings, clubs, separatistic spaces, and general interest topics; each network has an owner and appointed moderators.
evidence_quote: Interests and identities 524  Clubs 78  Regional gatherings 325  Private societies 116  Party coordination 43  Safe scene 23 … Start a group

name: Network-scoped discussion forums
description: Each Network contains threaded discussion boards visible and filterable by all-site, category (Sexuality & identity), followed, or own-networks scope; some threads are members-only.
evidence_quote: Discussions … Membership required … Followed discussions … Discussions in my networks … All discussions at Diversia

name: Event calendar with geographic and type filters
description: Community event calendar with country/region filtering, event-type filtering, add-event form, calendar grid view, list view, and a review tab for past events.

name: Detailed kink/identity profile taxonomy
description: Structured sexuality & identity profile section with multi-select fields across gender identity, intersex, gender expression, orientation, relationship form, power-dynamic roles, BDSM practices, garment/material preferences, body part preferences, bodily practices, and preferred social contexts (60+ taxonomy nodes).
evidence_quote: Gender identity … Attraction … Relationship forms … Power relations identities … Preferred BDSM practices … Preferred social contexts: Play parties  Munches  Cuddle puddles  Swinging / partner swapping  Group sex / orgies  Cruising  Sex clubs / saunas

name: Contact-intent preferences on profile
description: Structured 'what I'm open to' contact-type selectors on each profile (General contact, Friendship, Club company, Social kink, Guidance, Flirt, Sex chat, Sexual practices, Relationship, Other); drives the meet-others matching surface.
evidence_quote: Contact types: General contact … Club company … Social kink … Guidance … Flirt … Sex chat … Sexual practices … Relationship … You must respect what kind of contact each member is looking for.

name: Mutual interest matching ('Seems nice / interesting')
description: Members can flag other members as 'Seems nice / interesting'; when both parties flag each other, a Match is created and both are notified.
evidence_quote: Matches … When you stumble upon someone interesting, click "Seems nice / interesting". The more you express interest in that way, the greater the chance to achieve a match.

name: Advanced member search (requires substantial profile)
description: Filterable member-search with kink/identity taxonomy criteria; access is gated behind having a 'substantial profile' (picture + personal info + profile text + sexuality & identity data).

name: Profile visitor log (limited on free, expanded on VIP)
description: Profile shows recent visitors; free members see the last visitors but must fill in contact preferences before visitors are revealed; VIP members see up to 50 latest visitors and see 'directly who matches your interests' in the log.
evidence_quote: See up to 50 latest visitors to your profile … See more information about what others are seeking in contact ads and visitors logs - see directly who matches your interests!

name: Active-members directory with geo-filter
description: Real-time list of currently logged-in members (1,668 at time of scouting), filterable by country/region down to city level, with a friends-only view toggle.

name: Randomize (discover random member profile)
description: One-click 'Randomize' button navigates the user to a random member profile, acting as a serendipitous discovery surface.

name: People lists (custom curated member lists)

name: Profile with multi-tab structured layout

name: User-reported abuse with inline report links
description: Each piece of content (diary entries, pictures, discussions, confessions) carries an inline abuse-report link; reports go to a small admin team for manual review; persistent misuse can result in withdrawn functionality or account block.
